name: Vraska
aliases: a woman with hair like twisting vines
description: Vraska is a gorgon planeswalker and assassin of the Ochran from Ravnica who petrifies enemies with her gaze, rose to lead the Golgari, and is Jace's beloved.

summary.text: Vraska is a gorgon planeswalker and assassin of the Ochran from Ravnica who petrifies enemies with her gaze, rose to lead the Golgari, and is Jace's beloved.

bio.text: An early encounter shows her petrifying Relov, and she later tried to coerce or kill Jace in a plan to take over Ravnica, only for him to outwit her and for her to planeswalk away.

Years later, as captain of the Belligerent, she accepted Bolas's contract, which offered her the Golgari guildmastership in exchange for retrieving an item from Orazca, then spared the memory-less Jace and took him into her crew.
She grew to trust Jace, and after they learned the Immortal Sun imprisons planeswalkers, she had him hide her memories of him so she could deceive Bolas and sabotage him.
She returned to Ravnica in the War of the Spark, reclaimed her Golgari throne, and petrified pursuing Eternals, and she and Jace agreed to try a relationship.
On New Phyrexia she was infected and turned on Jace, and she was compleated to lead a Phyrexian legion against Ravnica, until Ral struck her down and Jace forgave her within her mind.
Jace later rescued her and reversed her phyresis, and her spark was gone, so she traveled with him and the child Loot and joined Oko's crew in a heist at Thunder Junction before betraying Oko.
In Reality Fracture she joined the strike team against the Theorist, took the fragments of Jace into her mind, stabbed the Theorist with an Ochran dagger, and held Jace as he died.

status.text: As of the latest story, Vraska is alive and grieving Jace, whom she helped carry out of the false Multiverse before Tam came to her at Ranna's door.

timeline.summary: Vraska enters, and Javy warns Relov not to look at her face as the gorgon sweeps into the room.
timeline.quote: "Don't look her in the face," Javy ordered Relov as the gorgon swept into the room.

timeline.summary: Vraska tells Relov she was cast into a dark tomb just before a guard would have killed her, and resolved that all should receive the death they deserve.
timeline.quote: I resolved that all should receive the death they deserve.

timeline.summary: Vraska lets Javy choose Relov's death, and Javy names inaction.
timeline.quote: Javy didn't hesitate. "Inaction," she said.

timeline.summary: Vraska reveals herself as a gorgon and planeswalker and says she wants Jace to prove he will be an ally of Ravnica.
timeline.quote: Before him was a gorgon.

timeline.summary: Jace deduces that Vraska wants to rule Ravnica, and she declares she is ready to kill him; the Jace she looks at is only an illusion.
timeline.quote: Instead of turning to stone, Jace melted away into nothingness.

timeline.summary: The real Jace emerges and has Vraska send her four assassins away; he deduces she wants to control him as Guildpact.
timeline.quote: So you want to leave me in the office of the Guildpact, and manipulate me.

timeline.summary: Vraska threatens Jace's allies and mentions Garruk Wildspeaker, hinting that something has happened to him, and tells Jace he is a plague.
timeline.quote: You're a plague, Beleren. A scourge to all those you claim to protect.

timeline.summary: Vraska strangles Jace with her tendrils; he reads her mind and conjures illusions of himself that attack her.
timeline.quote: Jace felt the gorgon's grip loosen as he sent image after image of himself at her.

timeline.summary: Vraska petrifies the illusions, which become a cage around her, and the statues speak in Jace's voice and trick her into explaining her plan to take over Ravnica.
timeline.quote: Then, one by one, I will assassinate the guild leaders.

timeline.summary: The statues reveal that Vraska's words have been broadcast to the guild leaders gathered at Sunhome.
timeline.quote: Your statements have been broadcast to all those who've attended.

timeline.summary: Vraska crushes what she thinks is Jace's neck but it is her own petrified assassin; the statues close in and she blasts them away and planeswalks off.
timeline.quote: Then she took a breath, closed her eyes, and planeswalked away.

timeline.summary: Ral explains that Vraska left Ravnica for no destination, as if into a void, and has not been seen since.
timeline.quote: She didn't planeswalk to a plane. Only from one.

timeline.summary: In a memory, Mazirek and Vraska share tea and talk of leadership and pride.
timeline.quote: If I am to be met with disrespect, then I must first love myself with a fierceness no fool can take away.

timeline.summary: Mazirek recalls meeting Vraska while consulting the Ochran assassins, and their friendship since.
timeline.quote: Mazirek trusted Vraska with his life.

timeline.summary: In a memory, Mazirek rages that Jarad has cut the kraul's food and ignored them, and Vraska suggests change without bloodshed.
timeline.quote: There are plenty of ways to enact change without shedding blood.

timeline.summary: The coffins open and the undead rise of their own accord, as Vraska had told him they would.
timeline.quote: the undead began to rise of their own accord, just as Vraska had told him they would.

timeline.summary: The ship the Belligerent finds Jace; its gorgon captain, Vraska, threatens him, then sees the state he is in and recognizes him by name.
timeline.quote: Jace, what the hell happened to you?

timeline.summary: Vraska finds an enchanted invitation from a dragon in her book and planeswalks to the Meditation Plane.
timeline.quote: she planeswalked through a dark slice in the air.

timeline.summary: Nicol Bolas hires Vraska, reading her mind and offering to make her Guildmaster of the Golgari.
timeline.quote: I can make you Guildmaster of the Golgari, Vraska.

timeline.summary: Bolas tasks Vraska with retrieving an item from the Golden City of Orazca on Ixalan, to be summoned by an associate.
timeline.quote: Retrieve the item that is there, summon my associate to transport it

timeline.summary: Vraska accepts, and Bolas bars her from double-crossing him.
timeline.quote: I accept your terms,

timeline.summary: Bolas gives Vraska the thaumatic compass and implants a spell to call his associate and knowledge of sailing.
timeline.quote: It is the thaumatic compass,

timeline.summary: Months later Vraska captains The Belligerent, and the compass directs her crew south.
timeline.quote: Set course due south,

timeline.summary: The crew spots a castaway on a seastack and Vraska recognizes Jace Beleren, resolving to petrify him.
timeline.quote: It was Jace Beleren.

timeline.summary: Vraska sees Jace is emaciated and ill, drops her petrifying gaze and asks what happened to him.
timeline.quote: Vraska snuffed the fire in her mind and looked down at him with no magic in her eyes.

timeline.summary: Jace tells Vraska he does not remember anything before waking on an island, and she concludes it is not an illusion.
timeline.quote: I don't remember anything from before I woke up on the first island.

timeline.summary: Vraska decides not to kill the harmless Jace and tells him he can stay until the next harbor.
timeline.quote: We'll prepare a hammock for you in the forecastle,

timeline.summary: Jace accidentally touches Vraska, who flinches because she has not been touched in years.
timeline.quote: She had not physically touched anyone in years.

timeline.summary: A Legion of Dusk ship appears and Vraska recalls an earlier attack and the vampires' pursuit of the Immortal Sun.
timeline.quote: The Immortal Sun was stolen from their monasteries

timeline.summary: Vraska orders an attack; Jace camouflages the ship and she silences it with an assassin's spell as they approach.
timeline.quote: The Belligerent was now imperceptible to any outside its rails.

timeline.summary: The crew boards the vampire ship and takes it by surprise.
timeline.quote: The vampires were caught completely off guard.

timeline.summary: Vraska fights the vampire captain with Jace's illusion clones and petrifies him when he grabs Jace.
timeline.quote: The vampire's skin and clothes turned to stone in her grip.

timeline.summary: Jace is amazed rather than afraid at Vraska's gorgon power and thanks her, calling her talented.
timeline.quote: Jace was not afraid. He was amazed.

timeline.summary: Vraska invites Jace to stay with her crew, and he accepts.
timeline.quote: I would love to.

timeline.summary: The soldier reveals that two pirate captains and a sun champion's vision are converging on Orazca.
timeline.quote: Forces are converging on your Golden City,

timeline.summary: The Belligerent lands at High and Dry, where the crew disembarks for revelry.
timeline.quote: the crew landed at High and Dry with no need for expensive supplies.

timeline.summary: Malcolm takes Jace and Vraska to the Boatswain's Rear for a private briefing.
timeline.quote: He opened the door (an old galley table with a knife still stuck in it)

timeline.summary: Vraska tells Jace about Lord Nicolas's contract and the compass, naming Orazca as their target; a River Herald merfolk protests silently.
timeline.quote: The thaumatic compass is enchanted to find a place of power: the forgotten city known as Orazca.

timeline.summary: Vraska tells Jace he is something else entirely.
timeline.quote: You're something else entirely.

timeline.summary: Jace asks if he can read minds, and Vraska confirms telepathically; he learns to silence the voices.
timeline.quote: Yeah, you can.

timeline.summary: Vraska tells Jace about Ravnica, and he conjures an illusion of the snowy city, which she admires with homesickness.
timeline.quote: Yes. This is Ravnica.

timeline.summary: Jace half-remembers a winged lion with a man's face and worries about the minds he may have broken.
timeline.quote: I wonder how many minds I have broken before,

timeline.summary: Vraska tells Jace of the Azorius's mass arrest of Golgari and her brutal imprisonment, her escape and her wish to lead the Golgari.
timeline.quote: They assumed I was Golgari because I was a gorgon, and they arrested me too.

timeline.summary: Jace encourages Vraska that she is meant to be a great leader, and each realizes neither wants to hurt the other.
timeline.quote: Both of them realized at the exact same moment that neither of them wanted to hurt the other.

timeline.summary: A storm and a Legion of Dusk ship converge as the ship nears Ixalan, and Vraska orders abandon ship.
timeline.quote: Jace saw the Legion of Dusk ship coasting atop the water.

timeline.summary: A wave sweeps Jace and Vraska off the deck and The Belligerent rams into the rocks.
timeline.quote: And The Belligerent rammed into the rocks.

timeline.summary: Jace and Vraska, who leapt overboard in the storm, swim ashore.
timeline.quote: he had leapt overboard alongside Vraska.

timeline.summary: Vraska petrifies another vampire with her gaze, warning Jace to close his eyes.
timeline.quote: A petrified vampire lay at his feet.

timeline.summary: Vraska reports that the crew has lost Edgar.
timeline.quote: We lost Edgar

timeline.summary: Breeches volunteers the crew to fight the Legion of Dusk while Vraska and Jace seek the Sun, to be tracked by Jace's illusion.
timeline.quote: We fight Dusk, you find Sun! Meet up later!

timeline.summary: Vraska orders the crew to leave the locals alone but kill every vampire.
timeline.quote: kill every vampire you find.

timeline.summary: Jace veils himself and Vraska in invisibility and hides their footprints as they flee upriver in the dinghy.
timeline.quote: He shut his eyes and dutifully willed a veil of invisibility over himself and Vraska.

timeline.summary: Vraska reveals to Jace that neither is from Ixalan and that she is a planeswalker, planeswalking in front of him.
timeline.quote: We're Planeswalkers.

timeline.summary: Vraska theorizes that Orazca holds the enchantment that stops them from leaving the plane.
timeline.quote: I believe that Orazca doesn't just contain the Immortal Sun.

timeline.summary: Jace works out that the compass points to blooms of powerful magic and aetheric north, which is why it pointed to him.
timeline.quote: We thought the compass was just pointing to the city, but it points to blooms of powerful magic.

timeline.summary: Vraska apologizes for hiding her planeswalking and thanks Jace for listening to her story.
timeline.quote: No one has ever listened to my story like you did. Thank you.

timeline.summary: Jace senses people nearby, including a minotaur.
timeline.quote: One human, one vampire, a merfolk . . . and a minotaur.

timeline.summary: Huatli glimpses Vraska among the wrecked ships.
timeline.quote: Her skin was emerald green, more reptilian than anything else

timeline.summary: Vraska steers the boat toward the bank as the river narrows, and the two planeswalkers camp in the boat for the night.
timeline.quote: We'll sleep in the boat,

timeline.summary: Vraska sings a Golgari song and talks with Jace before he falls asleep.
timeline.quote: The Golgari have little to be cheery about.

timeline.summary: Vraska decides she can trust Jace, possibly wants more than friendship, and resolves to petrify whoever stole his memories.
timeline.quote: Vraska knew in that moment that, memory or no, this was a man she could trust

timeline.summary: Vraska resolves to petrify whoever stole Jace's memories.
timeline.quote: Vraska couldn't wait to petrify whoever had stolen his memories.

timeline.summary: They abandon the boat and hack through the jungle, finding a dinosaur-made path.
timeline.quote: Vraska and Jace abandoned their boat the next morning.

timeline.summary: A vampire conquistador ambushes them under a cloud of dark smoke.
timeline.quote: A thick cloud of dark smoke suddenly flooded the grove around them.

timeline.summary: Jace dispels the darkness spell and Vraska fights the exposed vampire while Jace conjures an illusory storm.
timeline.quote: The dark smoke dissipated, leaving a conquistador standing exposed.

timeline.summary: The vampire knocks Jace down and steals the thaumatic compass, fleeing into the jungle.
timeline.quote: snagging the thaumatic compass from the ground at Jace's feet

timeline.summary: Tishana and Huatli introduce themselves and Tishana demands the compass or their deaths.
timeline.quote: Hand over the compass or die where you stand.

timeline.summary: Tishana betrays Huatli as the Belligerent crew ambushes them and Amelia binds Huatli in canvas.
timeline.quote: the slap of a large flap of canvas covering her face and knocking her off her mount

timeline.summary: Vraska petrifies Huatli's clawfoot and retakes the compass.
timeline.quote: Her clawfoot was in front of her, crouching for an attack, jaws wide open . . . and entirely encased in stone.

timeline.summary: Vraska explains how the crew caught up, using Malcolm in the sky and Jace's telepathy.
timeline.quote: It's much easier to find shortcuts with an eye in the sky and a telepath on the ground.

timeline.summary: The compass vibrates and Malcolm sees the city ahead as the crew runs through the fog and mountains.
timeline.quote: It's on the hills ahead!

timeline.summary: The crew sees the spires of Orazca.
timeline.quote: Shining as golden beacons above the green, the spires of Orazca pierced the sky.

timeline.summary: Vraska and Jace discuss what the Immortal Sun might do, joking about Lord Nicolas.
timeline.quote: Maybe Lord Nicolas is a rock collector?

timeline.summary: An earthquake shakes the clearing and Orazca begins rising from the jungle.
timeline.quote: The city itself was emerging from the jungle with every jostle of the earthquake.

timeline.summary: Malcolm says someone must have arrived at the city first, and a great beast bellows.
timeline.quote: Someone must have arrived at the city first.

timeline.summary: The city opens like a flower in gold, turquoise, amber and jade.
timeline.quote: The city itself had opened like the petals of a flower.

timeline.summary: Jace loses his grip on a boulder and tumbles down the waterfall as Vraska reaches for him.
timeline.quote: the ground jerked sideways once more, and Jace lost his grip.

timeline.summary: Vraska falls after Jace and is swallowed up by the pool at the bottom.
timeline.quote: Vraska was swallowed up by the pool at the bottom.

timeline.summary: Vraska is struck by a vision of Ravnica from Jace's mind while swimming.
timeline.quote: Vraska was still in Ixalan, but the image in her mind was of Ravnica.

timeline.summary: Vraska sees Jace's memory of becoming the Living Guildpact at the Forum of Azor.
timeline.quote: It was the day Jace became the Living Guildpact.

timeline.summary: Vraska realizes Jace is regaining all his memories and fears their friendship will dissolve.
timeline.quote: He would remember he was the Guildpact and she was an assassin and their friendship would certainly dissolve.

timeline.summary: Vraska realizes Jace's injury has left his mind unable to contain his memories.
timeline.quote: He broadcasted his memories now in bursts and stops, clearly trying to wrestle them back under control.

timeline.summary: Vraska is hit by an image of a broken white brick barrier at a harbor on a plane she has never visited.
timeline.quote: There was a massive barrier made of white brick against a turbulent sky.

timeline.summary: Vraska sees a memory of a half-metal man scarring Jace's back and forearm.
timeline.quote: dragged a manablade in long, arrow-straight lines down his back, then one single line down his right forearm

timeline.summary: Vraska sees a memory of a teenage Jace getting white tattoos from a Gruul shaman on Ravnica.
timeline.quote: The shaman leaned over the teenager and drew a line with his finger down Jace's cheek, leaving a brilliant white tattoo in its place.

timeline.summary: Vraska witnesses a memory of Jace asking a woman in violet if she will be sad when he dies.
timeline.quote: Will you be sad when I die?

timeline.summary: Jace chokes out the name Vryn as a memory of his home plane floods in.
timeline.quote: He choked out a single word.

timeline.summary: Vraska sees a memory of Jace's mother reading to him as a toddler.
timeline.quote: She was reading to her toddler from a notebook as she wandered the tiny kitchen

timeline.summary: Vraska sees that Jace was forced to forget his first planeswalks and mentally violated every time he remembered.
timeline.quote: the realization he had been forced to forget his first planeswalk

timeline.summary: Vraska experiences Jace's memory of facing the sphinx Alhammarret on a rooftop.
timeline.quote: the sphinx Alhammarret was crouched to attack in front of her.

timeline.summary: Vraska holds the weeping Jace, the first time she has touched anyone willingly in years.
timeline.quote: Vraska instantly dove to the ground and scooped him into her arms.

timeline.summary: Jace's memory shows Vraska singing a Golgari song aboard her ship.
timeline.quote: this Vraska was singing a Golgari folk song at the top of her lungs as her crew cleaned the ship.

timeline.summary: Jace's memory shows Vraska as a menacing figure the first time they met.
timeline.quote: It was the first time they had met.

timeline.summary: Jace says Vraska saw everything and acknowledges she is an assassin; she answers she is also a friend.
timeline.quote: You're an assassin

timeline.summary: Vraska apologizes for trying to kill Jace on Ravnica.
timeline.quote: I'm sorry I tried to kill you on Ravnica,

timeline.summary: Jace forgives Vraska for trying to kill him.
timeline.quote: I forgive you for trying to kill me,

timeline.summary: Vraska checks the compass, which points straight at the central tower.
timeline.quote: its light pointed an arrow-straight line toward the tower.

timeline.summary: Jace says the last three months were the best of his life.
timeline.quote: It was the best three months of my life.

timeline.summary: Vraska tells Jace the person who listened to her is who he really is.
timeline.quote: That Jace is still in you, and I think that Jace is who you really are.

timeline.summary: Jace speaks of his mother wanting him to be a scholar.
timeline.quote: My mother wanted me to move to the city to be a scholar.

timeline.summary: Vraska helps Jace up and they start to climb the staircase to Orazca.
timeline.quote: Vraska held out a hand to help Jace to his feet.

timeline.summary: Jace admits he used to be a coward as they climb.
timeline.quote: I used to be a coward.

timeline.summary: Jace climbs the golden stairs to Orazca, exhausted and in control of his memories.
timeline.quote: He deliberately placed each foot ahead of the other as he ascended the stairs to Orazca

timeline.summary: Vraska checks the compass at the top of the stairs.
timeline.quote: What we need is in there.

timeline.summary: A huge flying creature rises over Orazca while Jace hides them with an illusion.
timeline.quote: An immense dinosaur's head towered over the city.

timeline.summary: Jace tells Vraska he recalls the skills his mentor taught him.
timeline.quote: I can remember the skills my mentor taught me, now.

timeline.summary: Jace reflects that Liliana never called him incredible, unlike Vraska.
timeline.quote: Liliana never told Jace he was incredible.

timeline.summary: Jace solves the maze on the tower's back door.
timeline.quote: Jace started to trace the solution to the maze, a line of blue magically trailing his fingers as they moved.

timeline.summary: Jace realizes the door bears the Azorius symbol that appears when they try to planeswalk.
timeline.quote: It's the symbol of the Azorius.

timeline.summary: Vraska promises telepathically that no sphinx will hurt Jace again.
timeline.quote: You'll never be hurt by a sphinx ever again,

timeline.summary: The sphinx in the throne room announces himself as Azor and threatens Vraska.
timeline.quote: I am Azor, the Lawbringer,

timeline.summary: Jace shields Vraska's mind from Azor.
timeline.quote: Jace slammed a psychic ward between the sphinx and Vraska.

timeline.summary: Azor greets Vraska and Jace from his throne, asking who they have brought to seal.
timeline.quote: If this gorgon is not my prisoner, then who have you brought for me to seal?

timeline.summary: Azor calls the Immortal Sun the lock of his prison and Vraska realizes it is what traps planeswalkers.
timeline.quote: The lock of my prison, my finest creation.

timeline.summary: Azor binds Vraska with law magic through Jace's ward, but Jace frees her.
timeline.quote: A binding of glowing white runic magic grabbed hold of her torso and shoved her back toward the door behind them.

timeline.summary: Azor admits he left Ravnica when he finished and Jace admits he has not upheld his duties as Guildpact.
timeline.quote: Because Ravnica was one of many, and I left when I was finished.

timeline.summary: Azor reveals the Immortal Sun imprisons planeswalkers and that he gave up his spark to make it.
timeline.quote: I gave up my spark to help create the Immortal Sun, the lock of my prison, my greatest gift to all living things.

timeline.summary: Azor explains the failed plan with a friend to lure a foe to Ixalan.
timeline.quote: He was to lure our foe to a faraway plane and I was to use the Immortal Sun to enhance my hieromancy and summon that foe here, to Ixalan.

timeline.summary: Azor attacks Vraska and Jace; Vraska cuts his leg.
timeline.quote: Vraska unsheathed her sword and cut a long thin line across Azor's back leg.

timeline.summary: Vraska accuses Azor of causing centuries of war and her own suffering.
timeline.quote: The Immortal Sun has spawned hundreds of years of conflict on this plane,

timeline.summary: Jace takes responsibility to judge Azor as Living Guildpact.
timeline.quote: It is my responsibility to act on behalf of Ravnica.

timeline.summary: Vraska asks why Bolas wants a planeswalker prison and Jace says she needs to know who she works for.
timeline.quote: you need to know who you're working for.

timeline.summary: Jace and Vraska share everything they know about Bolas.
timeline.quote: Jace told Vraska everything he knew about Nicol Bolas.

timeline.summary: Jace realizes Vraska is meant to call Tezzeret to retrieve the Immortal Sun through the Planar Bridge.
timeline.quote: It's Tezzeret. He's the one you're meant to call.

timeline.summary: They deduce Bolas made a transportable army of Eternals and the Sun would trap anyone who arrives.
timeline.quote: He made an army he could transport across the Multiverse.

timeline.summary: Jace shows Vraska his memory of breaking into Bolas's mind on Amonkhet.
timeline.quote: He was trying to break into Nicol Bolas's mind.

timeline.summary: Vraska realizes Bolas wants her help to unleash an army on Ravnica.
timeline.quote: He wants to unleash an army.

timeline.summary: Vraska asks Jace to take and hide her memories of him so Bolas will not see them.
timeline.quote: I need you to temporarily take my memories of you.

timeline.summary: Jace recognizes the plan is to betray Bolas.
timeline.quote: You want to betray Nicol Bolas.

timeline.summary: Vraska lays out the plan to accept Bolas's offer of guild leader and wait until Jace restores her memories.
timeline.quote: He promised me the title of guild leader.

timeline.summary: They choose Niv-Mizzet as the one to help devise the plan.
timeline.quote: He could challenge Nicol Bolas both physically and mentally

timeline.summary: Jace and Vraska swear oaths to keep her memories safe and to sabotage Bolas when they are returned.
timeline.quote: I swear to commit my conscious self to his destruction.

timeline.summary: Jace sends Vraska's message to her crew, leaving Amelia in charge.
timeline.quote: Tell them to return to the ship, Amelia's in charge

timeline.summary: Jace promises to call Vraska Captain before restoring her memories.
timeline.quote: I'll call you Captain.

timeline.summary: Vraska invites Jace to a date at Tin Street Market and he accepts.
timeline.quote: It's a date.

timeline.summary: Jace seals Vraska's memories of him in a warded box hidden in her mind.
timeline.quote: She saw her memories of Jace tied up in a bundle, placed within a box, sealed with an unbreakable ward.

timeline.summary: Vraska wakes without her memories of Jace in the empty throne room.
timeline.quote: How did I get here?

timeline.summary: Vraska casts the spell that opens a violet portal beneath the Immortal Sun, which is pulled to another plane.
timeline.quote: when a violet circle opened up directly beneath the Immortal Sun

timeline.summary: The Immortal Sun is pulled away and Vraska planeswalks off Ixalan.
timeline.quote: As the portal closed, Vraska planeswalked away.

timeline.summary: Vraska returns to her chamber on Ravnica after the portal closes.
timeline.quote: she was standing back in her own chamber on Ravnica.

timeline.summary: Vraska finds Bolas's letter summoning her to the meditation plane.
timeline.quote: MEDITATION PLANE

timeline.summary: Vraska meets Nicol Bolas on the meditation plane.
timeline.quote: Nicol Bolas was waiting for her.

timeline.summary: Bolas scours Vraska's mind and replays her Ixalan memories.
timeline.quote: He peered into each corner of her memories of Ixalan and replayed them all in the blink of an eye.

timeline.summary: Vraska's memory shows a sphinx rampaging through Orazca, which Bolas accepts as true.
timeline.quote: watching as a sphinx rampaged through Orazca . . .

timeline.summary: Bolas rewards Vraska with a kingdom of her own design.
timeline.quote: You have earned a kingdom of your own design.

timeline.summary: Vraska feels uneasy that she may be missing something.
timeline.quote: She felt unsettled, though she could not remember anything that might be missing . . . or why.

timeline.summary: Bolas's note names her guildleader and gives a location for Jarad.
timeline.quote: HE IS ALONE AND IMPRISONED HERE

timeline.summary: Vraska prepares to petrify Jarad.
timeline.quote: and contemplated what she ought to say to Jarad before she petrified him.

timeline.summary: Jace thinks of the promised coffee and book with Vraska.
timeline.quote: His mind drifted to the promise of coffee and a book.

timeline.summary: Malcolm and Breeches, told by Jace to let Vraska go, find Orazca empty (non-canon pirate ending).
timeline.quote: Captain's orders are to let her go, Breeches.

timeline.summary: Months later Bozak tends zombies and learns that Boros officers have been exposed to zombie fungus, and Vraska fears Boros will use it to infiltrate the undercity.
timeline.quote: Three high-ranking Boros officers were exposed to the same type of zombie fungus we had been asked to gather.

timeline.summary: Hiding in a nook, Bozak overhears the lich telling Boros soldiers that he planted a devouring angel mushroom on Vraska's gown to frame her for the Tin Street massacre.
timeline.quote: Boros will have no choice but to charge Vraska with murder.

timeline.summary: Mazirek orders Bozak thrown out; Bozak tears his own arm free, swallows the devouring angel mushroom from Vraska's gown and leaps from the Keep.
timeline.quote: I grab the devouring angel mushroom on her gown and swallow it whole.

timeline.summary: Rat tells Teyo about the Living Guildpact Jace's absence and Vraska's assassination of Isperia.
timeline.quote: Mistress Vraska—she's the Golgari guildmaster—assassinated Mistress Isperia, the Azorius guildmaster.

timeline.summary: Rat overhears Jace defend Vraska's act against Isperia and thinks he may be in love with her; Gideon and Jace affirm their friendship.
timeline.quote: Vraska's vengeance was well earned!

timeline.summary: Azdomas says Mazirek was a Bolas collaborator revealed by Vraska and has paid the ultimate price.
timeline.quote: Mazirek was another Bolas collaborator, revealed by Queen Vraska before her departure.

timeline.summary: Vraska planeswalks in to claim her throne and the Golgari leaders bow to her without challenge.
timeline.quote: Madame Storrev, Mister Azdomas, Mister Varolz, and Miss Cevraya all bowed immediately, saying in unison, "No, my queen."

timeline.summary: Zarek mocks Vraska's pirate look, and Kaya and Zarek challenge her about returning to Ravnica.
timeline.quote: What are you supposed to be, a pirate?

timeline.summary: Rat urges Kaya to give Vraska the benefit of the doubt, and Kaya and Zarek accept Vraska's offer to help.
timeline.quote: Then Mistress Kaya sighed heavily and turned to Queen Vraska to accept her help.

timeline.summary: Ajani Goldmane, pinned down in an old chapel by Eternals, calls up through the grate and reports that Khazi was harvested.
timeline.quote: Khazi was harvested when an Eternal punched its hand right through the wall and grabbed her by the wrist.

timeline.summary: Ajani and Vraska introduce themselves; Vraska promises the Golgari will keep the civilians safe.
timeline.quote: Welcome to Golgari territory, Ajani Goldmane. You are safe here.

timeline.summary: Ravnican children and planeswalkers Mu Yanling, Jiang Yanggu and Huatli are lowered to safety through the grate.
timeline.quote: Miss Mu Yanling and Mister Jiang Yanggu

timeline.summary: Vraska turns three pursuing Eternals to stone, sealing the hole behind the last evacuees.
timeline.quote: Queen Vraska locked eyes with each of them in turn, transforming all three to stone.

timeline.summary: Vraska reports that the Golgari are opening pathways to safety across the city, winning back a little of Zarek's trust.
timeline.quote: We are fighting Bolas's army and preserving life.

timeline.summary: With the Golgari tunnels to Rix Maadi closed, the group surfaces and sees that the portal is gone from Tenth District Plaza, so the Planar Bridge has been shut down.
timeline.quote: Now, it was clear that Mister Fayden, Mister Karn, Miss Samut, and the Demon-Man Ob Nixilis had successfully shut down the Planar Bridge, as well.

timeline.summary: Vraska senses that the Immortal Sun has been shut down; the group chooses to stay and finish the work.
timeline.quote: It's down. The Immortal Sun has been shut down.

timeline.summary: Kaya insists Vraska come without her Golgari defenders so she can explain Hekara's death to the Cult.
timeline.quote: If the Cultists wanted an explanation (or demanded vengeance) for the death of Emissary Hekara

timeline.summary: The party descends the Demon's Vestibule past Rakdos performers, whose puppeteer shows a Hekara marionette that throws razors at Zarek and Vraska.
timeline.quote: Seemingly of its own volition, the Hekara puppet threw very real razors at Zarek and Vraska.

timeline.summary: The party reaches the Festival Grounds and enters Rix Maadi, which is strangely empty.
timeline.quote: Queen Vraska muttered, "Screw it," and marched through the arched gothic doorway.

timeline.summary: Dame Exava appears in a burst of smoke and the guildmasters beg an audience with the Defiler.
timeline.quote: We honor you, Exava, as a blood witch of rare talent, and we beg an audience with your master, the Defiler.

timeline.summary: Exava blames Hekara's death on the betrayal, denial and failure of Vraska, Zarek and Kaya.
timeline.quote: One of you betrayed her, one of you denied her, and one of you simply failed her.

timeline.summary: Hekara emerges from the Jester's Crypt alive, resurrected as a blood witch.
timeline.quote: What's your hurry, partners?

timeline.summary: Vraska apologizes to Hekara for betraying her trust.
timeline.quote: I owe you an apology, Hekara. I never should have betrayed your trust.

timeline.summary: Hekara admits she came without Rakdos's permission, and the leaders doubt the plan without him.
timeline.quote: The Boss didn't send me in his place. I totally came without his permission.

timeline.summary: Nissa leads the ritual; leylines light under the ten guild representatives and they fall into a trance with golden light pouring from their eyes.
timeline.quote: Suddenly, golden light poured out of twenty-one sightless eyes.

timeline.summary: Vraska and Jace reunite and agree to try a relationship after Bolas is dead or they are.
timeline.quote: So tomorrow we give it a try . . . after Bolas is dead or we are?

timeline.summary: Guild forces and planeswalkers charge the Citadel as the Dreadhorde engages them.
timeline.quote: Those Planeswalkers not fallen—or not yet fallen—were side by side with guild warriors, engaging the silent Dreadhorde.

timeline.summary: Planeswalkers debate what to do with the Immortal Sun, and Ajani insists the Gatewatch renew its purpose.
timeline.quote: we need to confirm that the next time a threat rises, the Gatewatch will be there

timeline.summary: The guilds assign Zarek to hunt Tezzeret, Vraska to hunt Dovin Baan, and hire Kaya to assassinate Liliana.
timeline.quote: And Kaya, the ten guilds wish to hire you to assassinate Liliana Vess.

timeline.summary: Vraska, the Wanderer, Kaito, Tyvar and Lukka planeswalk in to join, and Kaya wraps the sylex for the journey.
timeline.quote: Soon, others began to planeswalk in.

timeline.summary: Jace wakes and tries to run off, saying Vraska is in pain and calling to him.
timeline.quote: She made it down here, and she's alone and she's scared.

timeline.summary: The group finds Vraska, gravely wounded and surrounded by Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: bleeding profusely from a dozen terrible wounds, stood Vraska.

timeline.summary: Vraska tells Jace she is already infected and begs him to flee, saying she loves him.
timeline.quote: Run, Jace Beleren, and don't look back.

timeline.summary: Jace casts an illusion of a sunny Ravnican avenue so that he and Vraska can spend one more day together.
timeline.quote: The coliseum was gone, replaced by a sundrenched Ravnican avenue

timeline.summary: Vraska reveals Jace is also infected and kisses him as the illusion ends.
timeline.quote: You're as doomed as I am.

timeline.summary: Vraska, now loyal to Phyrexia, stabs Jace's hand with a scorpion-like tail dosing him with oil, and Jace flees.
timeline.quote: For the glory of Phyrexia,

timeline.summary: Vraska narrates being compleated: her throat and tendrils turn to metal, she petrifies Phyrexian agents until she is overwhelmed, and her self retreats into a hidden corner of her mind.
timeline.quote: I writhed and arched my back as Phyrexian oil rushed past my teeth.

timeline.summary: Vraska rides a Realmbreaker branch down over Ravnica as general for Elesh Norn and has it plunge through the Azorius Senate.
timeline.quote: I choose the simplest one and order a branch to dive straight through its center.

timeline.summary: Vraska's forces land at the prison where she was held, triggering a memory of her imprisonment at seventeen.
timeline.quote: It is the prison I was held in, the prison I tried, and succeeded, in escaping

timeline.summary: In a flashback, Vraska at seventeen is held by an Azorius guard, and Ludmilla is killed while calling to her fellow Golgari prisoners.
timeline.quote: And then, with a wet slice and a heavy thump, she was not. I was the only gorgon left.

timeline.summary: Vraska has Phyrexian agents blind the Azorius and Boros guards, and orders the blinded forced to the Transguild Promenade as an example.
timeline.quote: "Lead them to the Transguild Promenade as an example of what we do to the unjust."

timeline.summary: Vraska leads the Phyrexians into the Golgari undercity, transforming her people into Phyrexians while Realmbreaker upends Korozda and cracks Svogthos.
timeline.quote: It is a hive in the truest sense, all pieces of a single purpose.

timeline.summary: Vraska recalls singing with Jace on a boat on Ixalan.
timeline.quote: It is night on Ixalan, and I sing to the vast and buzzing jungle.

timeline.summary: Vraska's forces transform her subjects and defeat Selesnyan warriors in the undercity.
timeline.quote: a cohort of Selesnyan warriors tear through a hole in the maze

timeline.summary: Vraska enters her old apartment and finds the thaumatic compass, recalling the days before the War of the Spark when she reopened her memories of Jace.
timeline.quote: It is the weeks before the War of the Spark

timeline.summary: Vraska sees Ral Zarek and Tomik Vrona flying over Ravnica and feels jealousy.
timeline.quote: Ral Zarek and Tomik Vrona approach, flying close on the back of a gargoyle.

timeline.summary: Vraska orders her compleated Golgari to spill oil and blind the populace, leaving citizens collapsed in terror in the streets.
timeline.quote: "Spill as much glistening oil on the streets as you can,"

timeline.summary: Vraska's forces destroy the roof of the Chamber of the Guildpact and Niv-Mizzet's seat.
timeline.quote: delighting in crushing Niv-Mizzet's seat

timeline.summary: Vraska welcomes curious Simic and Izzet volunteers while others flee in terror.
timeline.quote: I motion to welcome them.

timeline.summary: Ral Zarek fights through Phyrexian ranks to reach Vraska, and hits her sternum with a cylindrical device attuned to Phyrexian oil.
timeline.quote: in one boxer's punch he plants it right on my sternum and hits a button.

timeline.summary: Vraska collapses, her broken body is deserted by her forces, and Ral walks away apologizing.
timeline.quote: My forces do not stay long enough for me to argue my case

timeline.summary: Vraska lies dying beneath rubble, half-flesh and half-metal, awaiting death.
timeline.quote: Now, I close my eyes and wait for the death Phyrexia promised I would never face alone.

timeline.summary: In her mind Vraska meets Jace at a café, remembers luring and betraying him, and tells him she deserves to die; he lets her share her memory.
timeline.quote: I betrayed him. I transformed him.

timeline.summary: Jace forgives Vraska and tells her the part that led the invasion was not her, entering the corner of her mind he made.
timeline.quote: "The you that kissed me wasn't you.

timeline.summary: Vraska and Jace share a kiss on a dreamed beach, a do-over, and Jace tells her he loves her too before a white light erupts.
timeline.quote: "I love you, too, captain."

timeline.summary: Two days after the invasion, Ral learns that an officer found no sign of Vraska's body after his haemalectric switch worked.
timeline.quote: "There's no sign of her body, sir."

timeline.summary: Malcolm recalls that Vraska reportedly died in the invasion.
timeline.quote: She'd died in the invasion, or so he'd heard.

timeline.summary: Teysa's remark about walking away stirs Kaya's memory of Jace and Vraska.
timeline.quote: Teysa had managed to invoke the shades of Jace and Vraska, the other two people who'd walked away from Ravnica.

timeline.summary: Oko introduces the rest of the crew, including Gisa, Geralf, Eriette and Vraska, as his second-in-command.
timeline.quote: And Vraska—an assassin from Ravnica—is my second-in-command.

timeline.summary: Vraska appears and Ral stops, stunned to see her alive; Rakdos knocks Ral aside.
timeline.quote: Rakdos swung a boulder-size fist into the lightning mage and sent him skidding off into the dust.

timeline.summary: Oko decides Kellan should join them, announcing that he is his son, over Vraska's objection.
timeline.quote: Besides, didn't you hear? He's my son.

timeline.summary: Kaervek reports that the artifact is not Thran or Phyrexian, and warns it could unleash another Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: You could be unleashing another Phyrexia on the Multiverse.

timeline.summary: Annie names an Outcaster named Nolan who can read the artifact, and Vraska says he is on a train to Prosperity under Sterling guard.
timeline.quote: "The man in question is currently on a train to Prosperity, escorted by Sterling mercenaries."

timeline.summary: Gisa and Geralf return with the map, revealing the path to Tarnation and the vault.
timeline.quote: "I believe this is what you were after."

timeline.summary: Oko plans to enter Tarnation disguised as Hellspurs with Vraska, Annie and Kellan to reach Akul.
timeline.quote: We'll split up the team and take a small group of four into the city,

timeline.summary: The infiltration team enters Tarnation, where Hellspurs duel openly.
timeline.quote: A small crowd jeered and roared, and when one of the axes landed in the other man's chest, the onlookers raised their arms in triumph.

timeline.summary: Three Hellspurs rough up Kellan and Oko intervenes, sparking a saloon brawl in which Vraska turns one Hellspur to stone.
timeline.quote: and used her gaze to turn them to stone.

timeline.summary: Twist Fandango and Akul's inner circle capture Oko, Kellan, Annie and Vraska.
timeline.quote: clamping a pair of iron cuffs to his wrists.

timeline.summary: Akul confronts the chained crew, takes the sixth key from Oko and assembles the full key in his medallion.
timeline.quote: Akul slotted the sixth key into the medallion

timeline.summary: Kellan challenges Akul to a duel; Oko and the others goad Akul's pride until he agrees to a duel at midnight.
timeline.quote: The duel begins at midnight.

timeline.summary: At midnight Kellan is brought to Tarnation's dueling grounds, while Oko, Vraska and Annie are chained in the stands.
timeline.quote: Oko, Vraska, and Annie appeared, still bound in chains.

timeline.summary: Tinybones frees the crew with a key, and Vraska petrifies the Hellspurs guarding them; Oko reveals he planned this.
timeline.quote: locked eyes with one after another until all of them were stone.

timeline.summary: Oko admits to Annie and Vraska that he leaked Tarnation's coordinates to Graywater to use the raid as a distraction, and that he brought Kellan because he knew he would get them caught.
timeline.quote: I brought Kellan with us because I knew he'd get us caught.

timeline.summary: Oko refuses to go back for Kellan and Annie reluctantly goes on to the vault.
timeline.quote: There was no time for a rescue mission tonight.

timeline.summary: The crew fights the Hellspurs while Kaervek works, and Vraska suggests she and Oko must reach the treasure at any cost.
timeline.quote: "You and I need to reach the vault's treasure room. No matter the cost."

timeline.summary: The ward breaks and Oko and Vraska descend, leaving the crew behind.
timeline.quote: He turned for the door without remorse, disappearing down the stairs with Vraska close behind.

timeline.summary: Kellan ropes Oko with a golden vine and Ral Zarek appears, confronting Vraska.
timeline.quote: A golden vine shot toward Oko's wrist, wrapping itself around his hand like a lasso.

timeline.summary: Vraska tells Ral the only way to fix what she has done is getting what is inside the vault.
timeline.quote: "The only way to fix what I've done is by getting what's inside the vault."

timeline.summary: Oko uses the key to open the vault door and enters the treasure vault.
timeline.quote: With the back of his hand, Oko wiped the blood from his chin, and stepped into the treasure vault.

timeline.summary: Vraska petrifies Oko, who planeswalks away before the stone reaches his head.
timeline.quote: "Your services are no longer required,"

timeline.summary: Kellan wakes to find Vraska, Jace and the child gone and the vault collapsing, and rescues Annie.
timeline.quote: By the time he reached her side, Vraska, the man, and the child had vanished without a trace.

timeline.summary: Jace wakes in a ravine feverish, tears out a cable from his arm and decides to save Vraska.
timeline.quote: he grasps one of the cables in his arm and rips it out.

timeline.summary: Jace planeswalks to Ravnica, which is at war with the Phyrexians, and searches for Vraska's mind.
timeline.quote: Ravnica is at war, again

timeline.summary: Jace finds Vraska wounded and compleated on a rooftop, and learns she has hidden herself in a mental recess.
timeline.quote: Her body is a mess of broken burned chrome.

timeline.summary: Jace performs five simultaneous telepathic feats to reverse Vraska's phyresis and carries her into the Blind Eternities.
timeline.quote: he closes his eyes and performs five miracles at once.

timeline.summary: Jace and Vraska collapse in the home of Jace's mother Ranna, a healer.
timeline.quote: Ranna Beleren, ever in control, hides her alarm at the bleeding monsters that fell into her living room.

timeline.summary: On Vryn, Ranna Beleren tends to Jace and Vraska, who arrive bleeding on her floor; Vraska asks her to save Jace first.
timeline.quote: "Save him first," Vraska rasps

timeline.summary: Ranna telepathically asks whether Vraska is Jace's wife, and Jace answers that she is his world.
timeline.quote: She is my world, mother.

timeline.summary: Ranna casts a ward and sedates the pair with a song.
timeline.quote: Ranna whispers to them both a song of sedation

timeline.summary: Ranna uses a phoenix feather to heal Vraska, and Jace learns his parents separated.
timeline.quote: It's a phoenix feather.

timeline.summary: Jace overhears Ranna telling Vraska that the old her is dead, mentioning a warrant for Jace's execution.
timeline.quote: The old you is dead. You can never be that person ever again.

timeline.summary: Jace and Vraska, disguised, visit an Omenpath on Vryn and decide something must be done about the portals.
timeline.quote: "Jace. We have to do something."

timeline.summary: Jace and Vraska decide the Multiverse is too broken to fix and settle on a rebirth plan inspired by phoenix feathers.
timeline.quote: "So, what if we do something other than fix it."

timeline.summary: Over months they accept their old lives are over and agree that rebirth is the just option.
timeline.quote: But rebirth … rebirth does both.

timeline.summary: Before leaving Vryn, Jace and Ranna say goodbye and promise weekly contact.
timeline.quote: "Once a week," Ranna says

timeline.summary: Vraska discovers she can no longer planeswalk, and Jace confirms her spark is gone.
timeline.quote: "I can't feel it. I can't feel it anymore."

timeline.summary: Jace vows to make meaning of their own; Vraska plots their plan on the wall.
timeline.quote: She turns her grief into purpose with furious alchemy

timeline.summary: Six months earlier, Vraska recruits Breeches and Malcolm in High and Dry.
timeline.quote: "Hello, boys. You sound like you need a job."

timeline.summary: Jace and Vraska reunite with the prize, a toddler-like child from the Fomori vault.
timeline.quote: The boy (Tamiyo's text said it was a boy) seems all too happy to take in the world around them.

timeline.summary: Jace reads the child's mind and learns his name is Loot.
timeline.quote: "His name is Loot."

timeline.summary: Jace sees that Loot's mind holds a map of the entire Multiverse and every Omenpath endpoint.
timeline.quote: It's the way to get from every point to every point.

timeline.summary: Jace and Vraska promise to protect Loot as their ward.
timeline.quote: Vraska and I will protect you with all of our strength.

timeline.summary: The three plan to walk through an Omenpath into the Multiverse, resolved that theirs will be better.
timeline.quote: Ours will be better.

timeline.summary: Jace apologizes for vanishing after the invasion and says he is searching for Vraska.
timeline.quote: I've been traveling with Vraska and our new companion.

timeline.summary: A projection on the ceiling shows Vraska shielding a small creature from blade-bodied monsters.
timeline.quote: There, projected on the ceiling, was Vraska, shielding a small, orange-furred creature with her body

timeline.summary: Vraska pulls Winter from the Speed Demons' wreck.
timeline.quote: Vraska tears Winter from the wreckage.

timeline.summary: Jace compels Winter to go limp and searches his mind for Loot.
timeline.quote: With another wave of his hand, Jace compels him to go limp.

timeline.summary: Vraska says they promised to keep Loot safe.
timeline.quote: We promised to keep him safe.

timeline.summary: Jace decides to take Winter prisoner as a loose end.
timeline.quote: I think we need to take him prisoner.

timeline.summary: Chandra sees Jace flanked by the Consulate's goons, with Vraska at his side.
timeline.quote: Her eyes find him where she least expected him: flanked on either side by the Consulate's powerfully muscled goons.

timeline.summary: Chandra's fireball passes through an illusion of Jace.
timeline.quote: An illusion. Of course.

timeline.summary: Vraska orders her group to apprehend Chandra hidden in a wreck.
timeline.quote: The pyromancer's in there. Apprehend her.

timeline.summary: Nissa sees Jace scoop up the limp creature.
timeline.quote: She turns to see Jace scooping up a limp, small creature.

timeline.summary: Jace calls Vraska away, leaving with Loot.
timeline.quote: We're leaving, Vraska,

timeline.summary: Nissa begs them to stay but a magical fog covers their escape.
timeline.quote: But by then, a haze of magical fog overtakes the clearing, and Nissa knows it's no use.

timeline.summary: In a flashback, Vraska urges Jace to stop using Loot's mind, saying Loot keeps trying to hide from him.
timeline.quote: He keeps trying to hide from you.

timeline.summary: In the flashback, Jace admits he reaches into Loot's mind, Vraska compares it to what he did to Chandra, and they argue over whether the cost is worth it.
timeline.quote: You hurt her, Jace. You hurt her badly.

timeline.summary: Vraska begs Jace to let the dead rest, and Jace refuses, insisting he must fix everything.
timeline.quote: I know what I have to do.

timeline.summary: Jace explains the realm is a hub of reality that he can mold by will, to save Vraska from what Phyrexia did.
timeline.quote: This place is a substrate to all of reality, touching countless worlds and moldable by sheer force of will.

timeline.summary: Vraska appears, changed and grief-worn, and tells Jace to stop.
timeline.quote: It was Vraska herself.

timeline.summary: Elspeth carries Narset and Loot through the Omenpath into the temple, where Vraska takes Loot.
timeline.quote: they were on the other side: outside the temple, Elspeth in the air, Vraska somehow beside her, arms held out for Loot.

timeline.summary: Narset climbs out and sees the sky black with dragons, and Elspeth names Sarkhan.
timeline.quote: "He's here."

timeline.summary: Vraska escapes with Loot under a camouflage spell as Narset and Elspeth decide to stand against Sarkhan.
timeline.quote: Tarkir is my home.

timeline.summary: Vraska lives with Ranna and Loot on Vryn, mourning Jace and wracked by guilt for turning away from him.
timeline.quote: Mostly what plagues her is guilt. She turned away from him.

timeline.summary: Chandra and Ajani arrive at the flat and tell them that Jace is alive.
timeline.quote: "Jace is alive," Chandra says, and in three words, Vraska's entire world falls apart.

timeline.summary: Chandra and Ajani explain that a gorgon working for Jace kidnapped an oracle, and Vraska deduces he needs knowledge of how planes fuse.
timeline.quote: "There was knowledge he did not possess, specifically about the fusion of planes."

timeline.summary: Vraska agrees to help reach Jace, and Ranna entrusts her with a wrapped package for him.
timeline.quote: "Yes." Vraska nods, wincing.

timeline.summary: Loot draws maps for Vraska, and she sends Chandra and Ajani to recruit Garruk on Muraganda.
timeline.quote: If we want a chance at making our way to Jace, then we'll need Garruk's help.

timeline.summary: Vraska, traveling to Strixhaven by Omenpath, camps in a swamp and dreams of General Beleren.
timeline.quote: She is in the center of an alder-lined war room.

timeline.summary: In the dream, General Beleren says he is the part that frightens her, kisses her cheek and says he can be both a good man and a monster.
timeline.quote: His lips graze her cheek. "I can be both ."

timeline.summary: Vraska wakes and realizes Jace is both good and monstrous, and that she may have made a mistake.
timeline.quote: He is both , she realizes with mournful shame, with defiant fierceness.

timeline.summary: Vraska enters the Echoverse through a mage-ring and finds details made for her, like the leaves matching her eyes.
timeline.quote: the yellow in the tree leaves is the exact same shade as her eyes

timeline.summary: Vraska meets Chandra, Ajani and Garruk after they slog through ooze, and they argue about Liliana, whom Garruk wants revenge on.
timeline.quote: "Stand aside and permit me my revenge," Garruk says with deadly calm. "The witch cursed me."

timeline.summary: The four climb the tower and meet a woman in white who embraces Chandra and says she came willingly.
timeline.quote: "I don't need to be saved. I came willingly."

timeline.summary: Garruk, Ajani and Chandra expose the woman as not Liliana, and Vraska punches her unconscious.
timeline.quote: Vraska doesn't hesitate. She swings her legs over the desk and socks Liliana at the angle of her jaw.

timeline.summary: The allies chase through looping halls and burst into Opal's office, where hours have passed and they are injured with lost memories.
timeline.quote: When did I get in a fight ?

timeline.summary: Ajani speaks Greek, Garruk's muscles twitch and Chandra is lost, showing Jace's effects; Opal says they fought Jace three times.
timeline.quote: "Oh, sweetie. You fought Jace three times."

timeline.summary: Vraska and her allies burst into the sanctum and Garruk, Chandra and Ajani collapse asleep at the Theorist's snap while Vraska stays standing.
timeline.quote: The four of them burst into his sanctum, and half a second later, three hit the floor.

timeline.summary: Vraska asks the Theorist to stop and gives him the horseshoe from his mother, which he drops, recalling the illusion of his childhood horse Pewter.
timeline.quote: how in the dark of night the child that was Jace snuck down and created a copy of Pewter to love with his whole heart.

timeline.summary: The Theorist insists he cannot be stopped, and Vraska asks how many will die.
timeline.quote: "How many will die, Jace?"

timeline.summary: Vraska tells him he is a killer who will murder billions, and he wipes her memory and sends the four out.
timeline.quote: her memory of the last few minutes is resting in the Theorist's hand.

timeline.summary: On the second attempt the Theorist freezes the group and shares a memory of how he rebuilt himself after dying.
timeline.quote: It is the day after he died. He is now they, and they have shattered.

timeline.summary: The Theorist cannot remember why he made Tam, saying only that she is important and must be protected, and wipes their memories again.
timeline.quote: I made a person, but this part of me does not remember why. She must be protected.

timeline.summary: On the third attempt Vraska says he will not convince them, and the Theorist realizes he can command them instead.
timeline.quote: "I don't need to convince you, " he commands, dark and gentle.

timeline.summary: He orders the others to stop each other, and they fight until he calls it off.
timeline.quote: "Stop the others from stopping me."

timeline.summary: Vraska tells him she hates what he has become, and he sends her to sleep and wipes their minds, leaving only the knowledge that he cannot be defeated.
timeline.quote: I cannot be defeated by you.

timeline.summary: Vraska realizes they only fought the Theorist, the worst part of Jace.
timeline.quote: "That's not Jace," Vraska concludes with a sick roil of her guts. "It's just what's left."

timeline.summary: Vraska sees Tam in a hallway and recognizes who she is.
timeline.quote: "Vraska," she says. "I know your name."

timeline.summary: Tam warns Vraska that the Theorist can only be beaten by a telepath and says the tower is made of his memories; she tells her to rescue Jadzi.
timeline.quote: "It isn't worth it to fight him directly. You need to rescue Jadzi before he can use her."

timeline.summary: Vraska realizes Jace knows he is going to die.
timeline.quote: Jace knows he is going to die.

timeline.summary: Chandra tells Vraska she wants her friend Jace back so she can kick his ass, and breaks into tears.
timeline.quote: I want my friend back so I can kick his ass!

timeline.summary: Chandra's cryomancer double appears and attacks the group with ice, and the allies jump out the window into the courtyard.
timeline.quote: "Dad says hi," says her double

timeline.summary: Doubles of Ajani, Garruk and Vraska arrive, and Vraska guides Chandra in a blind fight.
timeline.quote: "It's my double! It takes a few seconds for petrification to charge.

timeline.summary: Echoverse Vraska animates a statue of the Theorist that crushes Vraska and Chandra.
timeline.quote: It is Jace as the Theorist, twice as tall as the real one

timeline.summary: The Theorist asks Vraska to give up, but she spits in his face and demands Beleren back, and he throws them into a portal.
timeline.quote: Vraska feels herself being hoisted up then thrown through the portal into a vast and empty space.

timeline.summary: The allies fall into the tower's memory traps and find a marble plain with a well.
timeline.quote: It's an infinite plane of marble, endless and bare, with what looks like a well at the center of it.

timeline.summary: Chandra asks if Jace would have done this had she been nicer, and Vraska tells her she isn't that special.
timeline.quote: "You're not that special, Chandra."

timeline.summary: In a lecture hall they find the number of beings in the Multiverse on a chalkboard and meet the Detective, an aberration of Jace.
timeline.quote: Jace steps through, but not the one from upstairs.

timeline.summary: The Detective explains that the body is connected to the illusion and proposes that killing the body will stall the overlay, and that they need the Soldier.
timeline.quote: We'll need to find him. Then we'll have a chance to finish the task and eliminate the body.

timeline.summary: The Detective apologizes to Vraska, saying he loved all of them, and Vraska embraces him, saying we are who we choose to be.
timeline.quote: "You are no monster," she says with gritted teeth. "We are who we choose to be."

timeline.summary: The Detective says he chooses to be the man who kills his own ambition, and Vraska kisses him.
timeline.quote: "I choose to be the man who kills his own ambition."

timeline.summary: Vraska realizes that for the spell to slow, Jace's body must die.
timeline.quote: Vraska, lip trembling, finishes her conclusion. "You need to die."

timeline.summary: The Detective tells Vraska the Theorist must be stopped and that he must die; Vraska objects.
timeline.quote: The Theorist must be stopped , he says in her mind. I must die.

timeline.summary: The Detective explains that the spell destroying a Multiverse depends on their body being alive, so removing it is the only way.
timeline.quote: "Because the spell that is about to annihilate an entire Multiverse is contingent on our body being alive," says the Detective.

timeline.summary: Vraska tearfully shares her grief about losing him and the fear of forgetting; the Detective says she would betray him only if she never changed.
timeline.quote: Then you'd kill me a third time."

timeline.summary: The Detective asks the others to find the rest of his parts and hold them in their minds until they can be unified with the Theorist's body.
timeline.quote: You'll need to find the rest of me.

timeline.summary: Ajani pledges support and the Detective vanishes into Vraska's mind in a blue light.
timeline.quote: His body loses form, a steely blue light turns skin to vapor, and in the blink of an eye he is gone.

timeline.summary: Vraska and her allies enter a hall of phyresis, with the Detective commenting from inside her mind.
timeline.quote: The sight of phyresis makes Vraska's scars ache.

timeline.summary: The group sees an illusion of Elesh Norn, compleated Nissa and compleated Jace; Chandra and Ajani charge, but Garruk warns it is illusion.
timeline.quote: Ahead, in a massive room at the base of a massive tree, is Elesh Norn, gargantuan and gleaming, straddling the great roots of Realmbreaker.

timeline.summary: Vraska scents the true compleated Jace hiding at the back of the room, bleeding oil and pulling a sword from his chest.
timeline.quote: is the true compleated Jace, huddled on the ground, pulling a shining sword from his chest.

timeline.summary: Vraska takes in the Nihilist, who vanishes into her mind; the Detective reports that he is safe.
timeline.quote: "My turn to save you," she promises

timeline.summary: The World Tree booms and knocks everyone down; Garruk holds back Ajani as they escape through a portal.
timeline.quote: The Phyrexian World Tree pulses with light, and an immense boom from somewhere inside of it knocks them all to the floor.

timeline.summary: They emerge on Zendikar and decide to follow the portals; Garruk senses Eldrazi illusions.
timeline.quote: "Eldrazi are near. More illusions of them, anyway."

timeline.summary: Walking into the Singing City, the group's minds fill with telepathic noise from the voices of others and each other.
timeline.quote: This memory trap is the sensation of not being able to shut out the voices of other minds!

timeline.summary: They find another Jace huddled under an arch, covering his ears against the psychic noise: the Warden.
timeline.quote: It's the Jace who keeps the lid on the jar.

timeline.summary: Ajani tells Vraska she will not witness Jace's passing alone and that she is not helpless in this choice.
timeline.quote: "Vraska, Golgari Queen, is anything but helpless."

timeline.summary: Through the next portal the group falls to a rooftop memory in the rain, with Alhammarret's body dying.
timeline.quote: At the center of it all is a gargantuan sphinx.

timeline.summary: Garruk, Ajani and Chandra reach the portal, but Vraska, compelled by the sphinx, steps off the edge of the building.
timeline.quote: And as easily as one would step off the last stair, she steps over the edge.

timeline.summary: Compelled by Alhammarret to step off the Vrynian rooftop, Vraska aims her fall at a portal and steps off.
timeline.quote: She was commanded to walk, but she was not commanded to aim, and so she aims.

timeline.summary: While falling, Vraska thinks of her divided selves and invites her assassin self to join her fall.
timeline.quote: she sees herself, the assassin, and invites her to join this fall.

timeline.summary: The Soldier, a boy in a memory trap of a camp of dead soldiers, recognizes Vraska approaching and salutes her.
timeline.quote: The Soldier sees Vraska approaching and straightens into a salute.

timeline.summary: The Soldier asks for help and admits he is the reason she could not love all of him.
timeline.quote: "I'm the reason you couldn't love all of me.

timeline.summary: Vraska embraces the Soldier and tells him she loves him as she loves Jace.
timeline.quote: You're part of him, and I love you as I love him."

timeline.summary: The Soldier says death is a change in state and dives into Vraska's mind.
timeline.quote: he soundlessly disappears his body and dives into her mind.

timeline.summary: Vraska reaches the Guildpact in his prison in a ruined chamber; he warns that the Theorist has Jadzi.
timeline.quote: "The Theorist has Jadzi," the Guildpact warns.

timeline.summary: The Guildpact quits the Guildpact, spits on his desk, and Vraska turns the desk to stone before he joins her mind.
timeline.quote: Vraska stares at the desk and turns it to stone.

timeline.summary: Vraska sits beside the Survivor, who confesses he is afraid to die.
timeline.quote: "I'm afraid to die," he confesses.

timeline.summary: The Survivor declares that he does not want peace and that he is in progress.
timeline.quote: "I'm in progress."

timeline.summary: Vraska tells him she loves all of him, and he recites a Vrynian prayer of betrothal, asking her to be there for Tam.
timeline.quote: Encircle our union and bind our futures, pleasant and painful, spouse to spouse, marriage to death."

timeline.summary: Vraska offers to gift the Survivor a kind death, and he accepts before joining her.
timeline.quote: Let me at least gift you a kind death."

timeline.summary: Vraska arrives in the Implicit Maze and Chandra tackle-hugs her; Chandra explains that their doubles sent the group there.
timeline.quote: He had our doubles tackle us through portals, which sent us here.

timeline.summary: Vraska's double commands a stone Niv-Mizzet statue and guards the mage-ring with the other doubles.
timeline.quote: The other Vraska sits atop the head of a stone Niv-Mizzet.

timeline.summary: Vraska plans to be launched by Chandra's explosion to petrify her double, guided by the aberrations in her mind.
timeline.quote: "You're going to launch me high enough that I can petrify my double."

timeline.summary: Chandra launches Vraska into the air and she lands on the dragon's head.
timeline.quote: She is launched, and the wind—the wind!

timeline.summary: Vraska petrifies her double, freezing the dragon, and shoves the statue over the side.
timeline.quote: Skin turns to stone, and the other Vraska solidifies with a look of mild confusion on her face.

timeline.summary: Vraska takes her petrified double's dress as a disguise and leads the others through the mage-ring.
timeline.quote: Vraska raises the hood over her head.

timeline.summary: Vraska, in her double's disguise, stabs the Theorist in the heart with a knife while Chandra, Ajani and Garruk emerge from a portal.
timeline.quote: Something sharp pierces the Theorist's heart, and he gasps.

timeline.summary: Jace dies in Vraska's arms, unafraid, after thanking her.
timeline.quote: In the quiet of the sanctum with the now separated orrery overhead, Jace goes still.

timeline.summary: Vraska holds Jace's body and weeps as Chandra and Ajani embrace her; Liliana kneels and mourns him.
timeline.quote: Vraska holds the body of her beloved and weeps.

timeline.summary: Jace's spark rises from his chest as a blue light and shoots through an open window; Liliana demands to know what he did.
timeline.quote: the spark continues its climb up, out of his chest

timeline.summary: Vraska turns Ajani's double to stone with her gaze.
timeline.quote: Stone overtakes fur, and the doppelgänger dies with a snarl on his face.

timeline.summary: Liliana returns for Vraska and Jace's body and they haul him through the mage-ring away from the false Multiverse.
timeline.quote: Together, Liliana and Vraska haul Beleren's body through the mage-ring, away from the false Multiverse.

timeline.summary: After Jace's funeral, Vraska sits with Ranna Beleren as a quiet morning passes.
timeline.quote: He was laid to rest as a son of Vryn

timeline.summary: Tam arrives at Ranna's door, introduces herself to Vraska and says she is here to help make things better; Ranna drops her teacups on seeing Tam.
timeline.quote: "I'm here to help make things better."

timeline.summary: Abuse and discrimination in her youth shape Vraska into a revolutionary dedicated to overthrowing unjust systems on Ravnica.
timeline.quote: The abuse and discrimination she faced in her youth shaped her into a revolutionary

pages_say.description: A gorgon and planeswalker, though this page does not say so, who was torn from the world before a guard could kill her and now judges people with Javy's help; she turns Relov to stone.
A gorgon planeswalker and assassin who petrifies victims to lure Jace and plans to take over Ravnica through him.
A gorgon who planeswalked from Ravnica to no known destination and has not been seen since.
A gorgon, friend of Mazirek, who tells him how to bring about change without bloodshed and about the undead rising.
A gorgon who captains the ship the Belligerent and knows Jace; this page does not name her.
A gorgon assassin of the Ochran and planeswalker who accepts Bolas's contract to find Orazca and captains the ship The Belligerent.
A gorgon pirate captain with a compass, described by the soldier, who is said to have discussed her quest openly.
A gorgon captain of The Belligerent who confides her imprisonment by the Azorius and her hope to lead the Golgari.
A gorgon planeswalker who captains the Belligerent and seeks Orazca with the thaumatic compass.
A gorgon planeswalker, captain of the Belligerent, who races to Orazca with Jace and secretly comes to trust and like him.
A gorgon planeswalker and assassin who shares Jace's memories and comforts him.
A gorgon planeswalker and captain who accompanies Jace to Orazca.
A gorgon planeswalker and captain who confronts Azor and learns the Immortal Sun imprisons planeswalkers.
A gorgon planeswalker working for Bolas who sets up a sabotage by having Jace hide her memories.
A gorgon planeswalker who returns to Ravnica and, memories hidden, deceives Nicol Bolas into trusting her.
The crew's captain, whose orders are to let her go.
The gorgon planeswalker and Golgari guildmaster, whom Bozak saves from being implicated in a plot.
The gorgon Golgari guildmaster who assassinated Isperia.
The Golgari guildmaster, absent, who turned Isperia to stone and worked with Bolas.
A gorgon planeswalker and Golgari guildmaster who returns to Ravnica, reclaims her throne, accepts the task of helping and petrifies the Eternals blocking the escape.
A gorgon planeswalker and Golgari queen who accompanies the group to Rix Maadi to answer for Hekara's death.
A gorgon planeswalker and Golgari queen who reunites with Jace and is assigned to hunt Dovin Baan.

A planeswalker who was not with the group when they woke.
